guards.guard: a shadda is never transparent to the skeleton: a geminated radical occupies exactly ONE written letter position, never two
a GEM slot matches the written letter exactly like an ordinary radical slot; the doubling itself is a SEPARATE licence checked only after the shape has matched

the licence requires an EXACT declared environment: bound slot/radical AND a shadda source VERIFIED against the actual written surface at the GEM slot's own letter position -- a caller assertion alone never licenses the doubling

the licence is keyed to the template+slot's ATTESTED evidence basis, never to the literal radical letter -- any structurally-bound R2 is licensed exactly like any other given the same environment and an attested basis; nothing is licensed by default
triliteral doubling/gemination and quadriliteral templates are DISTINCT families and never collide by construction

mood and cross-clitic-boundary idgham are impossible category errors for a perfect-tense verb / participle template and are never consulted by this pack -- the geminate-root jussive alternation is a different root/template family this pack does not declare

this pack is a narrow rival to cu-voice-melody-templates/cu-passive-voice-vocalization and to inc-derivatives' mu_participle over the same letter-identical shapes; an unpointed Form II cell abstains under every rival pack, never a candidate under one while another abstains
a declared merge slot the pack cannot resolve to a real R-slot, or that disagrees with the template's own shape, fails closed rather than raising or guessing
method transfers, conclusions do not; per-token doubling needs per-token evidence
